verdict.rationale: Cognee automatically extracts entities and builds a knowledge graph from raw data (docs-16, docs-20), enriches it further via `.improve()` (docs-3, docs-31), and the CLI generates a 'Graph Insight Report describing what a dataset's graph contains' (docs-12) — all forms of AI-generated insight from ingested data. Recall also auto-classifies queries to pick the best retrieval strategy (docs-2/17/29), and a runtime probe confirms the demo pipeline actually produces graph-based answers locally (cognee-probe-rt-1). Missing for 10: no evidence of proactive 'suggestion' style outputs (e.g., recommendations, anomaly flags) beyond descriptive graph reports, and no independent review of insight quality.
